topic: Myth: My teen needs to focus only on school
caption:
We were told school comes first — and it does.
But your teen managing a $200/month side hustle on weekends? That's not a distraction. That's real-world education.
Time management, problem-solving, follow-through — hustle teaches what homework can't.
